biography:
I'm a professional energy development executive with full project life-cycle engineering background and extensive experience advancing utility-scale solar, wind, storage and transmission projects across the U.S. and North America. I’ve had the opportunity to lead projects from early-stage prospecting through construction and commercial operation, building high-performing teams, managing complex risk, and delivering over 2 GW of renewable energy to market. I take pride in navigating the technical, regulatory, and financial challenges that come with building real infrastructure that powers communities and enhances decarbonization. While at Lightsource bp, I cultivated a robust development pipeline, managing multi-million-dollar budgets, and oversaw the successful transition of assets and equipment from bp ownership into active deployment. I’ve also led cross-functional efforts around safety, team culture, and stakeholder engagement, always aiming to connect people to a shared sense of purpose and mission.

I am most driven by the opportunity to build strategies with multidisciplinary leadership teams, to work on impactful, cutting-edge projects that shape the future of energy in the U.S.  My passion is especially drawn to initiatives at the intersection of solar, storage, and transmission, where smart design,  engineering, interconnection market knowledge, and execution discipline create real value. Whether I’m negotiating land deals, mitigating project risks, or mentoring a team member, I bring a hands-on, solutions-oriented mindset to everything I do.

I’ve consistently led teams to higher performance by fostering an environment built on:
•	Clear communication that aligns teams around shared goals and expectations
•	Mentorship and coaching that fosters career development, accountability, and resilience. 
•	Collaboration across technical & non-technical disciplines, ensuring legal, finance, engineering, and field teams work in sync
•	Culture-building initiatives that enhance trust, engagement, and safety
•	Structured problem-solving that helps teams move through complexity with confidence

I'm currently open to opportunities where I can contribute to visionary teams pushing the boundaries of clean energy development and help bring the next generation of projects from concept to reality
